fullPassage: The idea of security can be considered to be one of the most fundamental of animal instincts. Every animal needs to feel secure and protecting from predators. The very existence of a species can be threatened if it cannot identify threats, communicate them to others in the species, and eventually develop a mechanism to challenge the threat. In the case of animals, there is a process of constant watchfulness to examine the surroundings and is aware of the presence of others in the space. Biologists have spent time studying the ways in which many birds and primates are able to keep an eye on their habitat, and when a threat is observed, the animals use a special kind of signal to communicate information about the danger to other animals in the space. This process has received scientific attention because it signals a level of cognition that can offer ways of understanding how animals communicate with each other. The key issue is that gaining a sense of security is an instinct that could be essential for the continued existence of a species.

questions.stem:
주어진 문장 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

The idea of security can be considered to be one of the most fundamental of animal instincts.

(A) Biologists have spent time studying the ways in which many birds and primates are able to keep an eye on their habitat, and when a threat is observed, the animals use a special kind of signal to communicate information about the danger to other animals in the space.

(B) Every animal needs to feel secure and protecting from predators. The very existence of a species can be threatened if it cannot identify threats, communicate them to others in the species, and eventually develop a mechanism to challenge the threat.

(C) In the case of animals, there is a process of constant watchfulness to examine the surroundings and is aware of the presence of others in the space.

det.korean: 도입문에서 '동물 본능으로서의 안전'을 제시한 뒤, 각 단락의 논리적 흐름을 추적한다.
det.analysis:
① (A)-(B)-(C): A가 생물학자 연구로 시작하지만, 그 전에 위협과 감시 과정의 배경 설명이 필요하므로 부적절
② (A)-(C)-(B): A가 먼저 오면 '위협 식별→소통→방어'라는 기본 전제 없이 연구 소개가 시작되어 논리가 끊김
③ (B)-(C)-(A): 도입문(안전=본능) → B(모든 동물이 안전을 느껴야 하고 위협에 대응해야 함) → C(동물의 경우 끊임없는 감시 과정이 있음) → A(생물학자들이 이 감시+신호 방식을 연구함). 일반론→구체 과정→과학적 연구 순서로 자연스러움 ←정답
④ (C)-(A)-(B): C의 '동물의 경우(In the case of animals)'는 앞에 일반적 진술이 있어야 하므로 첫 순서 부적절
det.tip: 'In the case of animals'는 앞서 제시된 일반 진술을 구체화하는 표지입니다.

④ 위치: 감시 과정 문장 뒤. 생물학자 연구와 환경 조건이 매끄럽게 연결되지 않음
